ModMetaData.name: Auto-hunt Manager
ModMetaData.author: alite
ModMetaData.description:
This allows you to set up hunting conditions similar to how you can set automatic slaughtering. The menu includes a section for setting the desired amount of raw nutrition, along with a toggle for insect meat counting as part of the stockpile. Wild humans and animals marked for taming will never be marked for hunting by the manager, and existing corpses will be prioritized as food sources when available.
